description: Start signing a Claude Code account in: runs `claude auth login` (with `--email` when the account has one) on the account's folder, or on ~/.claude for the global account, in a hidden terminal (no tmux window), and answers with the sign-in link (`url`) once Claude Code printed it. The page it opens shows a code to pass to tmux::accounts::login_code. `browser`: `none` (the default) keeps Claude Code from opening a browser on this computer; `host` lets it, for an app running on this computer: coming back from that page finishes the sign-in with no code (`browser_url` is the link it opened). The link works for 10 minutes (`expires_at_ms`); then Claude Code is stopped. A new start for the same account cancels the one under way. The feed's `logins` shows every sign-in under way (`waiting_code`, `checking`) and those that ended in the last minute (`done`, `failed`, `expired`). Signing in to another account on ~/.claude makes that one global (added when it is new). On macOS, Claude Code keeps the sign-in in the login Keychain, which only a worker running in the user's GUI session (a LaunchAgent, not an SSH or background shell) can write. Errors are one JSON object `{code: "failed", message}`.

LoginBrowser.description: Who may open the sign-in page on the computer the worker runs on.

oneOf.description: Nobody: Claude Code opens no browser; the link is shown elsewhere and the code from the page is pasted back.
Claude Code opens the browser there, whose return to its local listener finishes the sign-in with no code (the app runs on that computer).

account.description: Account id (`default` for the one `~/.claude` had at first).

browser.description: `none` (the default): no browser opens on this computer; `host`: Claude Code opens it here.

LoginBrowser.description: Who may open the sign-in page on the computer the worker runs on.

oneOf.description: Nobody: Claude Code opens no browser; the link is shown elsewhere and the code from the page is pasted back.
Claude Code opens the browser there, whose return to its local listener finishes the sign-in with no code (the app runs on that computer).

browser_url.description: With `browser: host`, the link Claude Code opened in this computer's browser, whose return finishes the sign-in with no code (it works on this computer only).

email.description: The email the page is filled with (the account's), when it has one.

expires_at_ms.description: When the link stops working and Claude Code is stopped (10 minutes).

login_id.description: Pass it to tmux::accounts::login_code and login_cancel.

url.description: The sign-in page, for any device: it shows the code to paste.
